headline: Does Gevo’s (GEVO) Board Refresh Signal a Deeper Shift in Its Low‑Carbon Innovation Strategy?
summary: Gevo, Inc. has appointed Todd Werpy, a veteran scientist and former Chief Science Officer at Archer-Daniels-Midland Company, to its Board as a Class II director, a role he began on August 20, 2026, with a term running through the 2027 annual stockholders’ meeting. Werpy’s background in commercializing bio-based technologies, carbon-efficient processes and biomass-derived chemicals adds deep technical and innovation-focused leadership that is directly aligned with Gevo’s low-carbon fuels and...
